## 🚨 Top 5 things to know
🌅 *What happened while I was sleeping:* US trade officials unveiled proposed Section 301 tariffs of 25% (or 17% with a trade pact) on 14 economies including India, while Nvidia blocked AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations. Meanwhile, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in 100 years due to severe weather warnings, and Wall Street closed for Thanksgiving following a partial recovery from tech sector jitters.

- ✅ OFFICIAL RULE / CHANGE — **📊 US Proposes 25% Tariffs on India and 14 Trade Partners**
  *What happened:* The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) proposed 25% tariffs on imports from India and 13 other trading partners, offering a reduced rate of 17% if a formal trade agreement is concluded [[Telangana Today]](https://telanganatoday.com/us-proposes-25-tariff-on-indian-goods-without-trade-deal). *Why it matters:* Indian export sectors face heightened cost pressures unless bilateral negotiations reach a swift settlement [[DW.com]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQR0NKVThESXhqamZNdUpfeTlkS3doTWxHS2ZBd3ktVFNUSHpQekM2cl9KWmRPQlF5Y0dZZEcwYnRfRjV0SmEza0xUM1ItU2NCNWtkVGI4R1ZyMElKaGtsZURHZ1R5TE1UMmpRQTVWTVB2c2pWQVhKQUdid3hZOHpzMU12eEVER1FBTzlWVU15SXVXNTd4aWJZMXM4Z1oxcV9JUlE?oc=5).
- 🟡 DEVELOPING — **💻 Nvidia Halts AI Server Shipments to Four Southeast Asian Countries**
  *What happened:* Following tighter US export controls targeting Chinese cloud access, Nvidia instructed partners like Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia [[The Decoder]](https://the-decoder.com/nvidia-halts-server-shipments-to-malaysia-singapore-thailand-and-indonesia-after-tighter-us-export-controls/). *Why it matters:* This disrupts billions in regional data center deals and forces dealers to seek alternative buyers for high-end chips [S76, S300]. ## ✅ What actually matters today
- ⚖️ COURT DEVELOPMENT — **Supreme Court Orders HDFC and ICICI Chiefs to Grant Sanctions or Appear**
  *What happened:* The Supreme Court directed the heads of HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank to grant prosecution sanctions in the NCR home loan subvention scam or appear personally before the court [[Bar and Bench]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* It increases accountability for top banking executives over delayed financial fraud prosecutions. *Who is affected:* Banking executives, home loan borrowers, and financial institutions. *What happens next:* Compliance with the court's sanction directive or personal court appearances by bank leaders.

  *What happened:* Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is set to step down next week following a rift with Walmart and growing uncertainty over the e-commerce giant's public listing plans [[TechCrunch]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPUW1VSUdycnBFSkJJYkhpODdhWHYwWkt1bWpmVmVZcVRaMmtBeWJoczY4c2xidDVORXdVYmVDcGFKUzRNS1BadTBJOEt2eENmZEd0djVqSktYbE05aXgyeGJjWDItVW82UkdyUm5XSmNfMmJXRENyRW8wdkUzY3hiVE9ybUxpa0FFZWpGV1FkbF9OaTVyZnFGNi02Wk45OFoydmhsTEY5VkMxMjJ1OHZpVUVR?oc=5). *Why it matters:* It signals executive turbulence at the top of India's leading e-commerce firm during a critical growth phase. *Who is affected:* Flipkart employees, marketplace vendors, and Walmart investors. *What happens next:* Announcement of interim leadership and restructuring of Flipkart's operational divisions.
- ⚖️ COURT DEVELOPMENT — **Second Federal Judge Blocks US Birthright Citizenship Order**
  *What happened:* A second US federal judge blocked President Trump's executive order attempting to curtail birthright citizenship after the Supreme Court rejected initial restrictions [[Latest articles]](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/26/world/trump-birthright-citizenship-judge-block/). *Why it matters:* It prolongs legal battles over constitutional citizenship rights for children born in the US. *Who is affected:* Immigrant families, legal scholars, and federal administrative agencies. *What happens next:* Higher court appeals and eventual Supreme Court review of the executive order.
- ✅ CONFIRMED — **SpaceX Authorized to Deploy 1 Million Orbiting Data Center Satellites**
  *What happened:* The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites for orbital AI data centers, drawing skepticism from scientists [S133, S341]. *Why it matters:* It represents a massive regulatory leap toward space-based computing infrastructure, though orbital congestion concerns persist [S133, S341]. *Who is affected:* Satellite operators, astronomers, and the global telecommunications sector [[AP News]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *What happens next:* Initial constellation deployment schedules and environmental impact reviews.

## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **What is a Variable Rate Repo (VRR)?** A Variable Rate Repo is a monetary tool used by central banks like the RBI to inject or absorb short-term liquidity from the banking system. Unlike fixed-rate auctions where the interest rate is predetermined, banks bid competitively for funds based on market demand. When the banking system faces tight cash conditions or high credit demand, the central bank uses VRR auctions to manage overnight interest rates and keep inflation in check.
